steps.instruction: Pick through 1 pound of beans, remove any bad ones and rinse thoroughly.
Put the beans and 8 cups of water in a large pot.
Add 1 1/2 cups of chopped onion, 1 cup of chopped celery and 4 bay leaves.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for 90 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat to low, cover and cook for about an hour and a half, or until the beans are tender.

steps.instruction: Stir the beans and mash some against the side of the pot with a spoon.
Add 1 cup of green pepper, 3 tablespoons of garlic and 3 tablespoons of parsley.
Add 2 teaspoons of thyme, 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 teaspoon of black pepper.
Cook uncovered over low heat for 30 minutes, until creamy.
Serve with hot cooked brown rice, if you like.
